description: Phase C section 8.6 starter catalogue; bodies are the files named here. Seeded by apps/api at signup (P3 plans) and by scripts/seed-playbooks.mjs; apps/api test/playbooks.test.ts asserts both agree.

playbooks.name: Clear temp files
playbooks.description: Removes files in the user and Windows temp folders (best effort) and reports the space freed.

playbooks.name: Restart Print Spooler
playbooks.description: Restarts the Print Spooler service and prints its status. Needs elevation.

playbooks.name: Collect logs (zip)
playbooks.description: Exports 24 h of System and Application event logs plus ipconfig /all and systeminfo into a zip, then asks the Desk to send it.
